responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic pretty-printing engine used by diagnostics and related textual emitters. It manages buffered formatted output, prefixing and line-wrapping policy, quoting and escaping conventions, GCC-specific checked formatting directives, URL embedding, and stream flushing, and on Windows it also translates ANSI escape sequences for console output, making this the concrete text-rendering backend beneath diagnostic.c and other users of pretty_printer.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the pretty-print pair: it contains the concrete formatting, buffering, wrapping, quoting, URL emission, and Windows console escape-handling code behind pretty_printer, whereas pretty-print.h defines the pretty_printer-facing types, macros, and function declarations.
